content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to create websites directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can establish a fully operational online store without incurring high platform fees. Unlike traditional e-commerce setups that rely on third-party payment processors, GitHub Pages empowers you to take control of your digital sales. This matters because it eliminates the financial overhead that eats into your profits. With GitHub Pages, you retain greater earnings, especially when selling high-volume items like ebooks or digital courses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages store combines several components to function seamlessly. Your product files are hosted on GitHub, while payment processing can be handled by services like NOWPayments. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed on-chain, ensuring security and transparency. Additionally, you can use Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of digital products post-purchase. This architecture not only ensures that you own your data but also provides a straightforward way to manage your digital commerce without reliance on external platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This setup is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment methods are not accessible. If you are an author, course creator, or designer looking to monetize your work without the burden of high fees from platforms like Gumroad, this infrastructure is for you. It allows you to focus on creating and selling while maintaining control over your financial transactions. This architecture is particularly beneficial for those in countries facing currency instability or payment rejections, providing a reliable alternative to traditional e-commerce solutions.
Eliminate platform fees and keep more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A GitHub Pages store utilizes various components that work in unison to create a seamless experience. The GitHub repository serves as the hosting ground for your digital products. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges just 0.5% per transaction. For product delivery, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers can be implemented to automate the fulfillment process. Together, these components create a sovereign commerce stack that gives you full ownership and control over your digital store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your GitHub Pages store, start by creating a GitHub account and setting up a repository for your products. Next, prepare your digital assets and configure NOWPayments for processing. Integrate Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of purchases. Test the setup to ensure that everything works as intended, and then launch your store. For a more comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all blueprints and templates needed to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use GitHub Pages to host your store and NOWPayments for processing payments. This setup allows you to keep more of your earnings while providing a seamless buying experience for your customers. With low fees and no reliance on restrictive platforms, you can effectively market and sell your digital products.
Automate digital product delivery for a seamless buyer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook online by utilizing GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This allows you to bypass traditional payment platforms, keeping your earnings intact.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to use GitHub Pages to host your digital products and integrate NOWPayments for low-fee cryptocurrency transactions. This structure eliminates high platform fees and maximizes your revenue.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by setting up a digital store on GitHub Pages and processing payments through NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without relying on Gumroad or Payhip.
How do I automate delivery of digital products?

Automate delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers in combination with your GitHub Pages setup. This will ensure that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
What are the fees associated with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of just 0.5% on transactions, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This allows you to retain more of your earnings.
